curated.tagline: Deterministic PWR plant simulator — real reactor physics in a walkable Unity control room
curated.description: An original, deterministic pressurised-water-reactor simulator: point kinetics with six delayed-neutron groups, xenon/iodine poison dynamics, decay heat, a reactivity ledger and lumped thermal-hydraulics, wrapped in a Unity control room built from procedural Blender assets. Educational entertainment built from published reactor engineering — a game, not a licensed training simulator.
highlights: Six delayed-neutron groups using Keepin data with analytic sub-stepping
Xenon and iodine poison dynamics including the post-shutdown xenon pit
Reactivity ledger: rod S-curve worth, absorber depletion, boron, Doppler, moderator, xenon
Procedural Blender assets feed the walkable control room
curated.architecture: C# simulation core (kinetics → poisons → decay heat → reactivity ledger → thermal-hydraulics) → Unity control room → procedural Blender assets
